title: TapSprint
description: Toggle sprint and sneak with a single keypress instead of holding the key down. Better for your hands, better for long sessions.
body:
## TapSprint

Holding sprint or sneak for hours is tedious. TapSprint lets you tap once to toggle sprint on, tap again to turn it off.

### What it does
- **Toggle sprint** -- tap V to sprint continuously
- **Toggle sneak** -- tap B to sneak continuously
- **Always-sprint mode** -- optional auto-sprint when moving forward
- **Smart detection** -- stops sprinting when you stop or run out of hunger

### How to use
- Default sprint: **V**, sneak: **B** (rebindable)
- Config via Mod Menu -> TapSprint

### Compatibility
Client-side only, works on any server.

## Changelog
### v1.0.0
- Initial release: toggle-sprint and toggle-sneak so you don't have to hold the keys.
